title: Disjoint-Set Queries
statement:
Implement union by size and path compression to maintain a partition of n singleton vertices.

Input
n q, then q operations UNION u v, SAME u v, or SIZE u.

Output
Print YES or NO for SAME and the component size for SIZE.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000. Vertex IDs are 1 through n.

samples.input:
4 6
SIZE 1
UNION 1 2
UNION 1 2
SAME 2 3
UNION 2 3
SIZE 1
